raw_spearman_signeddelta_vs_cn.note: direction: negative=more hypomethylation at higher CN

H_A_perposition_ALLELE.caveat: ALLELE axis is confounded by baseline allelic methylation (germline-het); not somatic-controlled. Reported for completeness only.

pseudoreplication.inflation_note: prior 5142 HP-sig RECORDS collapse to 5056 independent HP-sig POSITIONS; pseudoreplication inflated effective n by ~1.02x (HP1+HP2 of same locus are correlated).

pre_registration.falsifier: per-position coverage-controlled partial Spearman rho(|Δβ|,CN) > 0.2 AND p<0.05
pre_registration.support_threshold: |partial-rho| <= 0.1 OR opposite sign => NOT CN-driven (H-A holds)

decision_rule_result: per-position partial-rho=-0.0393 (|rho|<=0.1 or opposite sign) => NOT CN-driven; H-A HOLDS at per-position level
comparison_to_prior: per-RECORD partial-rho=-0.0551 (n=5142) vs per-POSITION partial-rho=-0.0393 (n=5056); both |rho|<=0.1 => H-A 'NOT CN-driven' verdict robust to pseudoreplication correction.
